question: What kind of yogic practice should be applied at the support-shoulder location?
premises: The practice is to be done at the ādhāra-skandha location.
Yoga is to be applied there.
The yoga is characterized as cool.
inference: One should apply a cooling yoga at the location of the support and shoulder.
uncertainties: ādhāra skandha saṃsthāne may indicate a specific anatomical or subtle locus
plain_english: One should apply the cooling yoga at the location of the support and shoulder.
